heroTitle: Traditional CRE systems are built to record the past, not navigate the future.
heroParagraphs: Most platforms function as static systems of record - expertly capturing payments and abstracts but struggling to bridge the gap between raw data and strategic outcomes. They show you where you've been but fail to forecast the impact of today's decisions on your P&L, employee experience, or enterprise risk.

C&D Consulting turns your data foundation into a decision engine. By combining deep domain expertise with a refined data architecture, we provide the "connective tissue" between your daily operations and your board-room goals. We don't just organize your data; we optimize it to increase revenue, slash operational costs, and future-proof your portfolio against risk.

cta.title: Stop Recording the Past. Start Navigating the Future.
cta.body: Most portfolios are sitting on a goldmine of data they can't actually use. Our Portfolio Data Audit is a high-impact diagnostic designed to identify where your "connective tissue" is broken and how much capital is currently trapped in your system of record.
bullets: AI Readiness: A clear assessment of how prepared your architecture is for the next wave of automation.
The Integrity Gap: Which data sources are currently undermining your decision-making?
The ROI Roadmap: A prioritized list of "Optimization" tasks that lead to immediate cost reduction and time savings.
